systems.system: National digital identity system (منظومة الهوية الرقمية)
systems.owner: High Commission for Digitalisation, developed in coordination with the Ministry of the Interior
systems.tiers: registration and appointment at the commune through the portal dzds.dz, then activation and verification against biometric data

note: The document describes the digital identity system and data governance only; it states nothing about the registration of births or deaths.
